Our Technology Advantage

Why We Are Different From Other Gold Jewellery Buyers

We use a German Karat Meter Machine for accurate, non-destructive and internationally trusted purity testing.

❌ Oldest Method To Test The Purity

  • ❌ Results can be inaccurate — purity is judged by eye on a touchstone
  • ❌ Often gives a lower value than the actual purity
  • ❌ Scratches your jewellery and uses acid
  • ❌ Still used by many buyers in the market

✅ German Karat Meter Machine

  • ✅ Internationally certified and trusted testing technology
  • ✅ Non-destructive test that keeps your jewellery safe
  • ✅ Gives an exact purity value (e.g. 22K = 91.6%) for a fair, transparent price
  • ✅ Result shown to you on screen, in front of you

Read the full comparison →

Gold Rate Today

Today's Gold Rate — and How Your Price Is Calculated

Your payout = net pure-gold weight × today's market rate. Purity decides the pure weight: 24K is 99.9% pure, 22K is 91.6%, 18K is 75% and 14K is 58.5%. Rates change daily, so we never print a stale number here — call us for today's live rate, then watch the same calculation happen in front of you at the counter.

  • Free German Karat Meter purity test — know the exact karat
  • Valuation at the day's market rate, explained line by line
  • No obligation — walk away if the offer doesn't suit you
